rooms.name: The Rusted Anvil
rooms.description: Smoke and the clang of hammer on steel fill the air. Sawdust covers the floor of this cozy tavern. A staircase leads up to the second floor, and a door leads north to the town square.

npcs.name: Grimmok Ironhand
npcs.description: A burly dwarf with a scorched beard and arms thick as tree trunks. He hammers rhythmically at a glowing blade, seemingly unaware of your presence.

rooms.name: Town Square
rooms.description: The cobblestone square bustles with activity. A fountain marks the center. The tavern is to the south, and the smithy is to the east.

rooms.name: Grimmok's Forge
rooms.description: The heat from the forge is intense. Weapons and armor hang from the walls. The town square is to the west.
